mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,project_id,eligibility_id,model_revision,config_id,verification_id,fixed_json,content_sha256,request_sha256,operation_id,idempotency_key,created_by,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS created_at,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,classification,status,CAST(revision AS CHAR) AS revision,receipt_json,audit_id,event_id FROM model_eligibility WHERE model_revision=#{modelRevision} LIMIT 2

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,eligibility_id,model_revision,config_id,verification_id,fixed_json,content_sha256,request_sha256,operation_id,idempotency_key,created_by,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS created_at,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,classification,status,CAST(revision AS CHAR) AS revision,receipt_json,audit_id,event_id FROM model_eligibility WHERE created_by=#{userId} AND idempotency_key=#{key} LIMIT 2
SELECT content_sha256 FROM version_registry WHERE version_id=#{eligibilityId} AND owner_project_id <=> #{projectId} AND entity_kind='MODEL_ELIGIBILITY' LIMIT 2

SELECT response_ref FROM operation_record WHERE operation_id=#{operationId} AND subject_id=#{creator} AND created_by=#{creator} AND operation_name='MODEL-ELIGIBILITY-ENABLE' AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND request_sha256=#{requestHash} AND target_id=#{eligibilityId} AND state='COMPLETED' AND http_status=201 AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest} AND classification=#{classification} LIMIT 2

SELECT resource_ref FROM audit_event WHERE audit_id=#{auditId} AND project_id <=> #{projectId} AND subject_id=#{creator} AND created_by=#{creator} AND request_id=#{operationId} AND trace_id=#{operationId} AND action='model.eligibility.enabled' AND result='SUCCESS' AND reason_code IS NULL AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest} AND classification=#{classification} LIMIT 2
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{eligibilityId} AND aggregate_revision=1 AND event_type='model.eligibility.enabled' LIMIT 2
